layer_3_action.subject: Vibrant mid-day view of forested volcanic highlands
features: Dark basaltic rock outcrops and black volcanic ash soil
Towering Araucaria and Ginkgo trees with feathery leaves
Lush understory of giant, sun-drenched ferns
Distant volcanic peak venting a small, white steam plume into a blue sky
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic landscape of a bright mountain slope where the ground is a textured, soft green carpet of mosses and ferns clinging to dark volcanic stone.

visuals.ground: Rich, dark volcanic soil and basalt rocks, completely carpeted in thick, emerald-green mosses and liverworts. Fern glades fill the spaces between ancient trees. No grass blades.
visuals.sky: Deep, clear mountain-air blue; brilliant high sun creates sharp, clean shadows across the ash-beds.
visuals.atmosphere: Crisp and clear; high-noon clarity with light shimmering off obsidian glass fragments in the soil.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Spongy bryophyte mats over hard, craggy basalt and silty volcanic ash.

negative_prompt: grass, lawns, meadows, prairies, dark shadows, gloom, sunset, scary atmosphere, 90s CGI, grainy, humans, buildings
